acceptance.description: Preserve W09.01–.08 full immutable records/shared inputs, IDs, legacy readers and serialized UTF8 body<=120000/batch<=240000/100-message limits, whole-invocation oversize/serialization refusal, exact positional receipts, immutable managed claims/grouping/CAS/cohort isolation and safe fixed numeric diagnostics. New durable mode may retry only stable proved-idempotent effects; explicitly supersede earlier bounded-task no-retry/no-DLQ-consumer/non-persistence exclusions only for this admitted coherent implementation. Do not reduce original W09 scope or undo earlier remedies.

Under existing owner authority, durably admit a bounded immutable logical operation before ledger/learning effects, binding original logical IDs/digests, exact frozen transport identities, destinations/attribution/config and original consent/owner/retention. Queue rejection, fallback, interrupted/lost acknowledgement and restart reuse it without new identity/lifetime. Failure or ambiguity in admission cannot claim durable acceptance; no uncategorized raw outbox or extra infrastructure service. Preserve literal-true opt-in/default-off compatibility and truthful unsupported legacy behavior.

Implement atomic LearnStats effect markers with counters: decision exposure identity; outcome+attributed decision+destination credit identity; exact repeats alreadyApplied, conflicting payload refuses. Persist immutable attribution before first credit, retry only missing effects, maintain original event time including zero/W23 decay and W24 compatible forward configuration. Retained whole/item technical reset-generation fences invalidate prepared old work without authorizing historical reset/rebuild. Bound markers/plans without dropping protection for retryable work; downstream waits remain outside ring lock, /recent responsiveness and actual owner-mediated caller timing are measured.

Real configured DLQ intake durably quarantines bounded cases before acknowledgement, binding provider/opaque identity, exact body commitment and truthful encoding/provenance. Intact managed redrive consumes original body/delivery identity/claims/ordinals directly; never regenerate producer IDs. Wrapper repair requires authenticated retained original proof. Malformed/unversioned/legacy records lacking sink idempotency remain explicitly unsafe, not silently converted to managed or labelled recovered. Logging, metadata-only capture or DLQ declaration is not closure.

Bounded list/status/redrive/resolve operations use opaque case ID plus expected digest/revision: proved ownership needs current human tenant administrator; unassigned cases current human stamp owner. No arbitrary storage key/replacement payload/tenant override or service-human session mixing. Existing D1 audit tables and narrow subject-audit route/enums record admission and outcomes; fail visibly on audit/storage uncertainty. Distinguish recovered, suppressed-erased, expired-unrecovered, irrecoverable and disposal-pending; unknown payload/row counts remain unknown and terminal loss never counts as recovered.

Recheck original grants/consent deadlines/owner epochs/retention/erasure for alarms, retries and operator recovery. Never persist reusable bearer authority, refresh original lifetime or invent tenant ownership. Physically expire/erase pending bodies, attribution, effect markers and quarantined copies while preserving necessary recovery/erasure barriers. Mixed-owner repair preserves surviving original ordinals/commitments with existing authenticated v2 proof, not a filtered envelope falsely satisfying whole claims. Restricted unknown-owner retention/disposal configuration is explicit and fail-closed unset; no actual policy durations, historical destructive cleanup or live authority inferred. Preserve bounded destination-cleanup references/continuation proof before erasing owner recovery keys, so cross-object markers remain discoverable for erasure.

Conserve source-operation counts separately from destination effects: expected, newly applied, already present, suppressed, pending/unknown and terminal loss. Reconcile actual sinks, not receipts alone; never sum ring/exposure/credit units into fictitious unique events. Focused faults cover byte limits/oversize, queue/R2/DO outages, committed response loss, interruption/restart, malformed/conflicting records, regrouping, duplicate sends, partial credits, expiry/withdrawal/erasure/reset during retry and audit/storage failure. Preserve existing downstream/report/replay reader compatibility, expose incompleteness and capacity limits rather than claiming W22/W30 closure.

Integrate explicit literal-true recovery intent through W08 desired-state/validation/resources, all three environment DLQ consumer declarations, guarded promotion and forward-compatible rollback closure. Default off stays off; false/unreadable intent or missing prerequisites never advertises durable-recovery readiness. Readers/consumers/erasers recognize already-managed state independently of producer activation. Preserve customer isolation, schema/credentials/telemetry and build-once artifact semantics. Use existing fixtures and concise API/deploy contracts, no new SQL migration/dependency/SDK regeneration/framework. Distinct whole-original-W09 actual artifact review and targeted independent fault tests required. Adding the DLQ consumer must extend W08 restore/continuation quiescence and real pause/readback to BOTH source and DLQ queues, preserve each prior pause state, and require fresh scoped resume authorization; the old no-DLQ-consumer safety assumption cannot survive activation.

Full/live/customer acceptance remains OPEN for separately authorized final batch: actual category/unknown-owner retention/disposal values, resource ownership/access/queue+DLQ consumer wiring, activation, real producer rejection and recovery with reconciled sink counts, deployment/browser/customer/SLO/retention/historical evidence. Local synthetic/native proof is not deployed/provider/customer acceptance; finite queue retention and unprovable legacy records remain explicit. No cloud/resource/credential/customer-data/external messages/commit/merge/push/deploy under local mandate.
